company_profile: SEGA Europe is the European publishing arm of SEGA, a games publisher whose London Data Services team builds data and AI capabilities for its studios and business teams.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs and ships LangGraph agents and RAG applications over enterprise data, with automated LLM evaluation, tracing and observability, alongside classical ML for prediction and forecasting. Works in Python, SQL and PySpark on Databricks with MLflow, and presents prototypes to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Enterprise Data Agent Platform
bullets: Built a LangGraph agent that answers business questions over lakehouse tables and internal documents, combining RAG with vector search and tools exposed through MCP servers.
Evaluated answers with LLM judges against a curated question set, tracked prompts and runs in MLflow, and served the agent behind an AI gateway through model serving endpoints.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role in your Data Services team. For the past year I have built LLM agents and RAG applications on enterprise data in healthcare, after several years of classical data science in telecom. What connects all of it is getting AI out of the demo stage and into the hands of the people who need it.

SEGA Europe publishes games from studios like Creative Assembly and Sports Interactive, and helping shape how AI is adopted across publishing and studio teams is the kind of problem I want next. There is a personal side too: my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

I would bring hands-on experience building agentic systems that business teams actually use. At my current role I built a LangGraph analytics chatbot that answers questions with PySpark analysis and live charts, and I set up LLM evaluation and tracing that cut human review by 43%. I also enjoy the workshop side: explaining what these systems can and cannot do.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about building for real users, carefully and with their feedback. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your team.
